tldr: Head: China cools fast — growth has fallen sharply in a week, and the map now sits in the scared-of-growth zone.
Head: Easing is stuck — the central bank has cut, but money markets still read tight, so the cut has not reached the system.
Head: Leaders are stretched — banks and coal sit near the top of their year-long range; the signal says they are extended, not good to chase.
Head: HK gets squeezed — the weak side of the currency peg is pulling money out, and the US rates push is tightening Hong Kong from outside.
Head: What to do: Get ready — the system is on alert, not yet in the trade.
summary: China is cooling fast while easing has not yet hit the system; Hong Kong is squeezed by the US rate push.
regime_read: China and Hong Kong both sit in the scared-of-growth zone. But the mainland has moved hard this week — growth readings fell from close to flat to clearly negative in five days. That is the drift worth watching: we are not settled in this zone, we are sliding deeper into it. Inflation is still weak, so this is not yet a switch into a hotter, reflation mix. The dominant driver today is the stuck easing. The central bank has delivered cuts, but the money-market corridor still reads tight. Policy says easier, plumbing says not yet.
conflicts: Head: Easing vs tight — the central bank is cutting, but money markets still read tight; the easing has not reached the system yet.
Head: Banks vs credit — banks lead the market strongly, but the credit impulse is fading; the lead looks borrowed, not earned.
Head: HK vs China — mainland is driven by domestic policy, Hong Kong by the US rate push through the peg; the two are splitting.
rotation_check: The stuck easing breaks the first leg of the playbook: policy is cutting, but liquidity is not flowing through yet.
transmission: If the stuck easing keeps up → banks and property keep leading on hope, not on credit.
If the US rate repricing keeps up → Hong Kong's peg imports more tightening, and outflows keep pressing the weak side.
watch_items: Sep 30 PMI: if weak, the cool-down deepens.
Money-market rate: if it drops, the easing finally flows.
Hong Kong peg distance: if it widens, outflows accelerate.
US 2-year yield: if it keeps rising, Hong Kong tightens more.

zh.summary: 中国正在快速降温，而宽松政策尚未传导至体系；香港则受到美国加息压力的挤压。
zh.regime_read: 中国和香港都处于增长恐慌区。但内地本周动作很大——增长率读数在五天内从接近持平跌至明显负值。这一趋势值得关注：我们并未稳定停留在此区域，而是在进一步滑向深处。通胀依然疲弱，因此这还不是转向更热、再通胀组合的转变。今天的主导因素是卡住的宽松。央行已经降息，但货币市场走廊仍然偏紧。政策说已经放松，管道却说还没。
zh.rotation_check: 卡住的宽松打破了策略的第一步：政策正在降息，但流动性尚未传导到位。
tldr: 标题：中国迅速降温——一周内增速大幅下滑，地图现处于“担忧增长”区域。
标题：宽松政策陷入停滞——央行已降息，但货币市场仍显紧缩，降息尚未传导至整个体系。
标题：龙头股已超买——银行与煤炭接近一年区间高位；信号显示已过度拉伸，不宜追高。
标题：港股承压——联系汇率弱势一侧正在抽走资金，美国利率上行正从外部收紧香港流动性。
标题：操作建议：做好准备——系统处于警戒状态，尚未进入交易。
conflicts: 标题：宽松与偏紧——央行正在降息，但货币市场仍然偏紧；宽松尚未传导至体系。
标题：银行与信贷——银行股强势领跑，但信贷脉冲正在消退；这种领先像是借来的，而非挣来的。
标题：香港与中国——内地由国内政策驱动，香港则通过联系汇率受到美国加息压力驱动；两者正在分化。
transmission: 如果停滞的宽松持续，银行和地产将继续靠预期而非信贷领涨。
如果美国利率重新定价持续，香港联系汇率制度将输入更多紧缩，资金外流将继续施压弱方。
watch_items: 货币市场利率：如果下降，宽松终于传导。
港元联系汇率偏离度：如果扩大，资金外流将加速。
美国2年期收益率：如果继续上升，香港将进一步收紧。
